title: Numerical Comparison of Distinct Constrained Derivatives
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Evaluate and compare (dw/dx)_y and (dw/dx)_z at the point (x, y, z) = (1, 2, 3) for w = x^2 + y^2 + z^2 and z = x + y.

steps.title: Evaluate (dw/dx)_y at (1, 2)
steps.why: Computing numerical value holding y constant.

steps.title: Evaluate (dw/dx)_z at (1, 3)
steps.why: Computing numerical value holding z constant.

steps.title: Compute Difference
steps.explanation: Illustrates that holding different variables constant produces completely different directional rates of change.
